description: Source code for a reset driver for Raspberry Pi Pico in Zephyr RTOS, implementing register read/write, status, and control functions.

methods.name: reset_rpi_read_register
methods.description: Reads a register value at a given offset based on register width.

methods.name: reset_rpi_write_register
methods.description: Writes a value to a register at a given offset based on register width.

methods.name: reset_rpi_status
methods.description: Checks the reset line status for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_rpi_update
methods.description: Updates the reset line state (assert/deassert) for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_rpi_line_assert
methods.description: Asserts the reset line for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_rpi_line_deassert
methods.description: Deasserts the reset line for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_rpi_line_toggle
methods.description: Toggles the reset line for a given device and ID.

methods.name: reset_rpi_init
methods.description: Initializes the reset device, mapping MMIO.
